scope: Actual sparse spatial audit. No patient-grouped inference or predictive fitting until S1 mapping and external cytokine signatures are verified.
OSM_policy: OSMR absent from actual panel; exclude from primary complete-receptor analysis. Inventory LIFR/IL6ST only; do not use alternate route to rescue primary results.
receiver: Primary: refined annot_new contains fibroblast (including myofibroblast), source broad Mesenchymal, xenium4 confidence >=0.8, and >=2 detected structural fibroblast markers (COL1A1,COL1A2,COL3A1,DCN,LUM,PDGFRA). Also report all annotated fibroblasts and all mesenchymal cells as separate sensitivity denominators.
annotation_policy: Author confidence is not independent identity validation. Marker corroboration is reported explicitly and is not substituted for orthogonal protein evidence. Do not fit new cell identities using outcomes.
sender: Primary immune classes B and B plasma, Myeloid, T and NK cells; no self edges. Quantify ligand expression in all source lineages separately.
background_screen: Per biosample, ligand and every receptor subunit must have >= max(2, 1+empirical 99.9th percentile of per-cell negative-control probe+codeword counts in QC cells), and exceed the same cell's total negative controls. This is a conservative aggregate-control screen, not a calibrated per-probe error model. Missing per-probe controls remain a limitation.
sensitivity: Upper bound: raw >=1 molecule, no background or spatial constraint (receptor competence bounds possible exposure). Also raw >=2 and >=3 molecule co-detection. Do not choose favourable thresholds.
radii: 1.5, 2.5, 4 times each biosample's median QC segmentation-equivalent diameter from cell_area; nominal 2.5. Units follow unscaled standard Xenium centroids/area with 10x documentation.
background_robustness: Report screen exposures and receptor-only permissive bounds. Exposure is transcript-based plausibility, not measured protein occupancy or secreted ligand.
gene_exclusions: All ligand/receptor inputs; all primary annotation/marker genes and explicit state-label marker genes must be excluded from external outcome dictionary before overlap/counting. Cell-type DEGs stored in uns are not cytokine perturbation signatures.
sample_mapping: Use complete biosample identifier plus embedded biobank where available and workbook row/SCP order; never collapse donor_id to independent patient. Keep mapping provisional until S1 verified, and keep exact crosswalk under ignored data/.
stopping_rule: If fewer than two programmes can possibly reach >=20% receiver coverage even under >=1-count complete-receptor upper bound across specimens, do not fit or impute receptors. Unresolved signature/mapping gates remain NOT EVALUABLE. No held-out validation before prerequisites pass.
